issue_context.title: PemEncoding.TryFind can produce an ArgumentOutOfRange exception
issue_context.body:
Code to reproduce:

```csharp
string contents = @"
CN=Intermediate1
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MII
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
CN=Intermediate2
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MII
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
";
PemEncoding.TryFind(contents, out _);
```

review_comments: The `+=` used to be right back when an earlier implementation maintained two spans, one for  the "real" user input and another for where we are currently looking. However that was refactored away and all of the offsets used are now absolute values in to the original PEM string. So we shouldn't accumulate the offset anymore.
